They strip rank the surface for raw materials to feed the Imperial factory.|Ryder Azadi and Ezra Bridger|}} '''Ore crawlers''', dubbed "'''World Devastators'''" by those who seen them in action,''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' were a type of a crawler used by the [[Mining Guild]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]]. They were used to strip rake the planets surface for raw materials to feed [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Factory|factories]]. One such crawler, [[crawler 413-24]] was [[Hijacking of Crawler 413-24|hijacked]] by the [[Spectres]] so they could use its [[communications array]] to contact [[Alliance High Command]]. ==History== The [[Mining Guild]] dispatched [[ore]] crawlers across the [[planet]] [[Lothal]] to strip the land for raw materials to be used in the mass production of [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] armaments in the [[Imperial Armory Complex]] and Imperial [[Factory|factories]]. [[Crawler 413-24]] was dispatched to the southern hemisphere of the planet. Locals who saw the machines in action referred to them as "World Devastators" due to how they moved on giant repulsorlift legs sucking up the ground beneath them.''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' {{Veh-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The design for the ore crawlers was based on the look of the [[World Devastator]]s used by the [[Dark Empire]] in the comic book miniseries of the [[Star Wars: Dark Empire|same name]].{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/crawler-commandeers-trivia-gallery|text="Crawler Commandeers" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 2}} In a sense, the ore crawler and World Devastator do the same thing. They strip basic minerals from a given surface and use them as raw materials for the Imperial production of fighters and starships. The difference is the Devastators were factories themselves, whereas the crawlers transported their product to factories elsewhere.''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' It would later be noted in ''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' that World Devastator is an unofficial moniker for the ore crawlers. ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Crawler Commandeers}} {{1st}} *{{Rebels|Jedi Night}} *{{Rebels|A Fool's Hope}} ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|67|Databank A-Z}} {{Imo}} *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/crawler-commandeers-episode-guide|text="Crawler Commandeers" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' {{1stID|World Devastator}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|guild-slave-master-proach|Guild Slave Master Proach}} *{{Databank|ore-crawler|Ore Crawler}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Reptador minero |ja=鉱石クローラー }} [[Category:Repulsorcraft models]]
